systemMessages.974: The soul crystal succeeded in absorbing a soul.
systemMessages.975: The soul crystal was not able to absorb the soul.
systemMessages.976: The soul crystal broke because it was not able to endure the soul energy.

systemMessages.978: The soul crystal is refusing to absorb the soul.

rules:
1) STAGE MEANING: in "stages" (and in the datapack) a number is the CURRENT crystal stage the monster ACCEPTS; a success turns stage N into N+1. Example: Timak Orc stages [0,1] = it levels a stage-0 or stage-1 crystal, so it can give at most stage 2. "givesUpTo" = max(stages)+1. The user-pasted table and pmfun use that "givesUpTo" number ("Stage 2: Timak Orc"). A crystal whose stage is not in the list gets message 978 (refusing).
2) Every regular monster in the datapack accepts stage 0 (all have maxLevel>=1), so a fresh crystal can be started on any of them; there are no datapack monsters below level 40.
3) QUEST: quest 350 must be STARTED (Jurek Giran / Gideon Oren / Winonin Aden). No level check in the L2J script (web guides say level 40). A new crystal (stage 0, free) is only handed out when the character holds no soul crystal at all. Clicking "Quit" abandons the quest; without the started quest nothing absorbs.
4) ONE CRYSTAL: the character must hold exactly ONE soul crystal (any colour, any stage 0-18). Two or more = nothing absorbs (retail message 977 resonation; in the L2J script it is silently skipped). Broken crystals 4662-4664 do not count.
5) REGULAR MONSTERS (crystalUseNeeded=true, absorb LAST_HIT, chance 9): target the monster, get it to <= 50% HP, use the crystal (skill 2096, range 300, 1.2 s cast, 26 MP), then the SAME character must land the killing blow. If the crystal was used above 50% HP, or someone else kills it, nothing happens (no message). Re-using the crystal later updates the recorded HP. L2J rolls getRandom(100) <= chance, so chance 9 = 10% per kill.
6) Failure (975) keeps the crystal. In H5 L2J the crystal NEVER breaks (exchangeCrystal is always called with broke=false; message 976 unused). Some old guides say crystals shatter - not in this datapack.
7) RAID / GRAND BOSSES (crystalUseNeeded=false): no crystal use needed. FULL_PARTY = every party member holding one valid crystal rolls the chance. PARTY_ONE_RANDOM = ONE random party member (picked among ALL members, also those without a crystal) rolls; so 9 members = 1/9 of the chance each. Killer must be in a party for party types. The L2J script has no distance check, but stay close (retail behaviour / server customisations).
8) Stage 13 crystals do not absorb by themselves except on bosses that list stage 13. Stages 10+ only on bosses; regular monsters stop at accepting stage 9 (giving 10).
9) L2Toggle may use custom rates/lists (web servers show 15%). Not verified live; verify with the first kills (messages 974/975/978).
userTableCheck: The user-pasted table matches the datapack exactly when its "Stage N" is read as "can give up to stage N" (= datapack maxLevel+1 = givesUpTo). Checked 2026-10-07: every name in it exists in levelUpCrystalData.xml with exactly that value and every datapack regular monster is in it (77 names / 102 npc ids). Name differences: client says "Maluk" (user "Malruk"), "Veil Master" (user "Vale Master"); the user-listed "Pirate-s Zombie Captain" is id 20845. Its "Stage 11-12" boss list = bosses accepting stage 10/11; its "Stage 13" list = bosses accepting stage 12 (Anakazel 25338, Antharas, Ember, Scarlet van Halisha, Valakas). Caveats: Zaken (29022), Baium, Anakim, Lilith also accept 12 (+13) at 5-10%; Ember accepts 10-13 at 5% FULL_PARTY.

buy.note: Paid with grade crystals (Crystal: D 1458 / C 1459 / B 1460 = what crystallizing gear gives), NOT adena. The forum guide (topic 503) says "for crystal stage 10 go to the Giran luxury shop, Alexandria, Purchase Specialty Items". A bought crystal only levels when quest 350 is STARTED and it is the only crystal in the bag.

q350Code.mark: DATAPACK (Q00350_EnhanceYourWeapon.java levelSoulCrystals / getSCForPlayer / levelCrystal; L2J H5)
rules: getSCForPlayer: quest 350 must be STARTED, and the bag must hold exactly ONE item that is a soul crystal of any colour, stage 0-18 (two or more = null = no roll at all, no message from the script).

LAST_HIT monsters (every regular monster): the KILLER must be in the monster's absorber list (= he used the crystal on it) and his crystal use must have been at <= 50 % of the monster's max HP; else nothing. Only the killer's crystal rolls.

So a character that never lands killing blows (our healers only heal) can NOT level a crystal on regular monsters: its crystal use only costs MP. Healers level on FULL_PARTY bosses, buy (Alexandria, stage 7-10) or get one levelled by a damage dealer (trade / warehouse).

Party monsters (any non-LAST_HIT entry = all bosses): the killer's party is checked (no distance check in the script); maxSCLevel = the highest member crystal stage the boss accepts; no crystal use needed.

FULL_PARTY: every member holding one valid crystal rolls. PARTY_ONE_RANDOM: ONE member is drawn from ALL members (also those without a crystal); a member without a valid crystal = nobody levels (the code comment calls it retail behaviour).
PARTY_RANDOM is declared but used by no entry in levelUpCrystalData.xml.
Roll: getRandom(100) <= chance, so chance N = (N+1) %. Success = the crystal is replaced by the next stage (974). Fail = 975. Stage not accepted = 978. The crystal never breaks in H5 (976 unused).
The boss must be killed by OUR party (killer.getParty()); another party's kill gives us nothing.

forum503.mark: GUIDE (community.lineage2toggle.com topic 503, Arthose 2023-01-02; a copy of an rpg-club x50 guide, NOT L2Toggle data; 3 of the 4 "other raid boss" images and the NPC screenshots are lost)
steps: Take quest 350 at the Magic Guild in Giran or Aden (the datapack also has Gideon in Oren).
Stage 10 crystals: Giran luxury shop, Alexandria, "Purchase Specialty Items" (the datapack multisell sells stage 7-10 for grade crystals).

Raid boss table colours: RED = 100 %, every party member levels; YELLOW = random chance, each member rolls; GREEN = one random party member levels. The forum column = the stage the crystal REACHES (datapack accepted stage + 1).
conflicts: Anakazel 78: forum YELLOW (every member rolls), datapack 25338 PARTY_ONE_RANDOM 15 % [12,13] (green). Stages agree. The forum leaves out Anakazel 68 (25337, 5 % PARTY_ONE_RANDOM [10,11]).
Scarlet van Halisha and Freya (normal): the forum shows a GREEN stage 17; the datapack stops at accepted stage 15 (gives up to 16).
Lost Captain / Lost Warden (81): forum GREEN 11-14; not in levelUpCrystalData.xml at all (no absorb on stock L2J).

Zaken: forum "night time 60" = datapack 29022 (100 % FULL_PARTY [10,11], 10 % [12,13]); forum "daytime HARD 83" = 29181 (PARTY_ONE_RANDOM 20/10/3 %). The datapack XML COMMENT swaps day/night; npcs_h5.json names all three plain "Zaken". 29176 (60, 10 % one random [10,11]) is not on the forum.
Forum names: Orphen = Orfen, Anays = Anais, Takeurakan = Taklacan, Darnel = Darnels, Cannibalistic Leader Stakato = Cannibalistic Stakato Chief, Ant Queen = Queen Ant.
The forum gives no percentages; Ice Knight Captain (25699/25700) and the mid-level bosses are not on the surviving images.
Not verified on L2Toggle Kain: rates and lists may differ (first kills: watch messages 974/975/978 in Logs/soul.log).
